author: Justclause8989
quote: Honestly, I waited so long for this and I'm just disappointed.After about 20 hours, GTA 6 looks amazing, I'll give it that. Vice City looks incredible at first. But actually playing it is a chore. The pacing is so slow. Long drives with nothing happening, slow walking sections, cutscenes you can't skip, missions that are basically go here, wait, drive back. It feels padded just to make it **** the bugs... I've had it crash twice, NPCs just freezing in the middle of the road, cars disappearing when I turn around, audio cutting out during missions, and the frame rate drops hard in busy areas. For a game that took this long and costs this much, that shouldn't be happening.There's also just less to do than GTA 5. Most buildings you can't even enter, the activities feel limited, and the map looks big but a lot of it feels empty once the wow factor wears off. GTA 5 gave you three characters, proper heists, and way more freedom to mess around. This feels more restricted, not less.I wanted to love it, but right now it feels like a pretty tech demo with a slow story attached. Hoping patches fix a lot of it, because at the moment it's worse than GTA 5 for me. 1/10
